events.title: Crusaders sack Béziers and massacre its people
events.description: The army of the Albigensian Crusade stormed Béziers and killed much of its population. A chronicler later attributed to the papal legate the words 'Kill them all; God will know his own'.

events.title: Edward I defeats William Wallace at Falkirk
events.description: English longbowmen broke the Scottish spear formations at Falkirk, ending Wallace's career as a field commander. He was captured and executed in 1305.
events.html: English longbowmen broke the Scottish spear formations at Falkirk, ending Wallace's career as a field commander. He was captured and executed in 1305.

events.title: John White's colonists arrive at Roanoke Island
events.description: More than 100 English settlers led by John White landed at Roanoke, intending to found the 'City of Ralegh'. When White returned in 1590 they had vanished, becoming the 'Lost Colony'.

events.title: Hood attacks Sherman in the Battle of Atlanta
events.description: Confederate General John Bell Hood struck Sherman's armies east of Atlanta, killing Union General James McPherson. The attack failed, and Atlanta's fall in September boosted Lincoln's re-election.

events.title: Wiley Post completes the first solo flight around the world
events.description: Wiley Post landed at Floyd Bennett Field, New York, after circling the globe alone in 7 days, 18 hours and 49 minutes. An autopilot and radio direction-finder made the feat possible.
